info.title: Aboard Host 001
info.description: Single structural authority for feature 001; behavior in specs/001-host-workspace-foundation/contracts/api.md, digest byte protocol in data-model.md §4. Designed, not implemented or operational acceptance.

x-transport-policy.host: exact actual listener authority; reject absolute-form and ambiguous Host
x-transport-policy.origin: reject any Origin and browser preflight; no CORS/cookies
x-transport-policy.sessionDelivery: SID-protected, peer/server-verified local operator named pipe only; no public HTTP login
x-transport-policy.disconnect: detach waiter only; never cancel accepted business operation

x-operation-policy.existingKey: current authorization + same actor/input; return original association before epoch/expiry/base checks, never re-admit
x-operation-policy.changedInput: OPERATION_KEY_REUSE; do not leak another actor receipt
x-operation-policy.unknown: fence dependent writes; prove old physical completion and fresh consistent exclusive view; missing receipt alone is not rollback; no replay or new key retry
x-operation-policy.close: process-local coordination history, not durable save receipt; after restart unavailable history is not success
x-operation-policy.registration: current installation identity/grants never imported from directory
x-operation-policy.compatibility: format=2; schema=1 each DB; known ordered ledger/checksums + user_version must agree; open/inspect never upgrade or seed
x-operation-policy.capacity: per workspace 32 and installation 64 unfinished HTTP operations; reject before admission, reserve progress for investigation/drain; not Native/Build budget

Location.description: Same-authority relative operation path; no token or original filesystem path.

localSession.description: Verified current installation/tenant/principal and grants on every request and before business transaction. Not JWT claims or workspace-provided authorization.

UUID.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDv4; 16 digest bytes follow display hex order, never GUID memory order.

Revision.description: Canonical unsigned decimal string in [0,9223372036854775807]. Numeric JSON, leading zeroes and overflow rejected.

Path.description: Locator only, never an identity or grant. Operator, allowed-root, local NTFS and physical path checks required before target access. Never echoed in ordinary DTOs/errors.

locationLabel.description: Redacted operator-approved label, never absolute path.

InspectionView.description: Successful closed/quiescent source inspection only. Does not register, authorize or open the target; unsafe/incomplete input returns an explicit error.

CandidateValidation.description: Returned only after Host structural/dependency/baseline checks; not execution authority.

OperationView.description: Independent logical/physical/persistence axes. Save receipts persist; close coordination history is process-local and loss after restart is OPERATION_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE, not inferred success.

ErrorView.description: No paths, SQL, Win32 raw errors, text, tokens or secrets. Unknown is never safe-to-retry; retain original workspace and operation key.
